title: Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset
relevance: Primary dataset for this project. All chronological batches, feature counts, and class labels used on this site are verified against this source.
notes: Fetched and verified directly from the UCI dataset page before being cited here.

authors: Gama, J., Zliobaite, I., Bifet, A., Pechenizkiy, M., Bouchachia, A.
title: A survey on concept drift adaptation
relevance: Foundational survey of concept-drift adaptation strategies; frames why this project treats chronological (not IID) evaluation as the primary protocol.
novelty_threat: Establishes the general concept-drift vocabulary but does not address electronic-nose sensing, TinyML deployment, or explanation stability — this project's combination remains distinct.

title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30 (NeurIPS 2017), pp. 4766-4777
relevance: Reference explainer against which any resource-aware / proxy explanation strategy in this project would be evaluated for fidelity (planned, not yet executed).
novelty_threat: SHAP itself is not resource-aware and is not evaluated here for on-device / TinyML deployment cost, drift-stability, or physical energy — this project's resource-aware angle is distinct.

authors: Ribeiro, M. T., Singh, S., Guestrin, C.
title: "Why Should I Trust You?": Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
venue: Proceedings of the 22nd ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2016)
relevance: Alternative local-explanation baseline relevant to the planned fidelity/stability comparison for resource-aware explanations.
novelty_threat: Same as SHAP: not evaluated for TinyML resource constraints or drift-stability in the original work.

title: TinyML-Enabled Frugal Smart Objects: Challenges and Opportunities
venue: IEEE Circuits and Systems Magazine, 20(3), pp. 4-18
relevance: Survey framing for the TinyML deployment constraints (Flash, SRAM, latency, energy) this project targets for the nRF52840 / Cortex-M4F stage.
novelty_threat: Surveys general TinyML deployment, not sensor-drift-aware models or on-device explanation cost — this project's drift + XAI + hardware combination is not covered.
